title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=e^{\left(-x^2\right)}$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{0.8-0}{4}=0.2$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$0$$, $$0.2$$, $$0.4$$, $$0.6$$ and $$0.8$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$S_4=\frac{1}{15} \left(f{\left(0\right)}+4f{\left(0.2\right)}+2f{\left(0.4\right)}+4f{\left(0.6\right)}+f{\left(0.8\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$0.658$$.
